title: EsTable Options Configuration
description: Configuration object for @es-plus/vue3 EsTable options prop

heightType.description: Height calculation mode. 'height' recommended for adaptive height with ResizeObserver

tabHeight.description: Height offset reserved for tabs/toolbar above the table when computing adaptive height

cachePageSelection.description: Persist checkbox selections across page changes

rowkey.description: Row unique identifier field name. Required for cross-page selection

httpRequest.description: Custom request handler. Signature: (params: { url, method, headers, formParams, pageIndex, pageSize }) => Promise<response>

configTableOut.description: Map backend response field names to internal fields. Uses recursive key lookup (no dot-path needed)

total.description: Field name for total record count in response

tableData.description: Field name for data array in response

pageSize.description: Field name for page size in response

current.description: Field name for current page number in response

entryQuery.description: Default query parameters when no form is connected

leftText.description: Text displayed on the left side of the table toolbar

virtual.description: Enable virtual scrolling for large datasets. The rendering engine is target-specific: vue3 switches to the el-table-v2 engine; antdv forwards `virtual` to <a-table> (Ant Design Vue 4 native virtual scroll). Vue 2 + Element UI has no equivalent — it warns and degrades to a plain el-table (vue2's large-data path is `engine: 'vxe'` instead). Safe to set on any target.

engine.description: Table rendering engine, an alternative to `virtual: true`. 'default' = el-table / a-table / el-table, 'virtual' = the target's virtual engine (vue3 el-table-v2; antdv <a-table :virtual>; vue2 has no equivalent and degrades to a plain el-table with a warning), 'vxe' = vxe-table, available on all THREE targets — vue3, antdv and vue2 each ship a vxe adapter, and vxe-table itself supports Vue 2. 'vxe' is therefore the large-data path for vue2, where 'virtual' is not available.

rowHeight.description: Row height in pixels for virtual mode (vue3 / el-table-v2 only)

estimatedRowHeight.description: Estimated row height for dynamic-height virtual scrolling (vue3 / el-table-v2 only)

overscanCount.description: Number of rows to render outside the visible area (vue3 / el-table-v2 only)

rowClassName.description: Custom row class name. String or function (({ row, rowIndex }) => string)
